instructions: Divide the page in 3 rectangles using a ruler, Then, on each frame, draw an horizon line and one vanishing point to the center. On each frame, draw a rectangle, place the back corners, following the vanishing point. Finally, construct all of the edges of the box. Repeat this process 4-5 times per frame. For detailed instructions, click here.
goal: The goal of this exercise is to separate students from the explicit reliance of plotting back to the vanishing points, and getting used to the fact that parallel lines converge.
